goal_level_decision_audit.other_path: Keep only the PIP route and accept no M7 topology row. That remains valid if this active-count contract fails scale or review.
goal_level_decision_audit.was_i_foolish: No for this gate. It requires full-scale shape-pair count, stable same-contract counts, complete M3 metadata, and external review before any row can count.
